title: Throat Wobble
description: A dark throat-like square sub that wobbles with deep slow vibrato so its pitch never settles, while a subtle tremolo pulses it like breathing. Over the loop the filter slowly opens and closes in stepped stages and the bit-crushed grit thickens, giving a hollow vocal-cord growl that morphs without any reverb.
code:
setcpm(84/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 g0 c1 c1 ds1 g0 c1>*2").s("square")
    .vib("<3 5 7 4>/8").vibmod(perlin.slow(13).range(0.7, 1.6))
    .lpf("<300 420 260 540 360 480 220 600>/2")
    .lpenv("<2 3 1.5 2.5>/11").lpattack(0.06).lpdecay(0.22).resonance("<6 9 7 11>/7")
    .ftype("ladder")
    .crush("<8 6 5 7>/16").shape(saw.slow(23).range(0.15, 0.4))
    .tremolosync("<2 3 4 6>/16").tremolodepth(tri.slow(16).range(0.25, 0.6))
    .penv("<0 -3 0 -5>/8").pattack(0.005).pdecay(0.09)
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.coarse(3))
    .gain(0.85)
)
